clock.scope: Supervisor process clock; cross-process/runtime mapping is not established by this record.

rootPollCpu.coverage: Child-usage counter delta when the original root poll reports terminal status. Cached or synthetic status does not prove that this poll reaped the root. Recursively accumulated terminated-child CPU may be included; live reparented descendants and missing kernel usage records may be excluded. This does not prove complete tree coverage. Do not add this aggregate to descendant sampled CPU.

coverage: Observed descendants including detached browser groups; sub-sampling-lifetime children and processes reparented before observation may be missed. CPU sums maximum observed process time per PID/start identity, preserving work when zombie accounting resets; it is not an exact kernel tree accounting. ps CPU precision is platform-dependent (centiseconds on macOS, whole seconds on the pinned Linux image). RSS is a concurrent sum, not summed per-process maxima.
